title: Eleven new ways to quest
changes: Nine new quests that ask more than killing: carry the last spirit lantern to Brinewood, hold the mill for Odo, find the empty grave in Gravemoor, sneak past the Thornspire watch, turn the Vault's twin seals with a friend, and follow a crowned seal through the Kharsun sands.
Choices that stick: Old Garrick's two letters decide who trades with you, and Grandam Ursk offers you her hide instead of a fight. Captain Hale will remember either way.
The Tide: every blob slain fills a meter shared by everyone. When it is full, the Gloam's leftovers march on Oakvale's west gate at dusk. Hold the gate for gold and runes.
Mags the alewife has three new rumours on the square every day, and veterans can tell Captain Hale they'll see a recruit through their first boss. Both earn titles, shown under your name.
